author: c. m. ralston
title: 427 students enrolled at Stewardson-Strasburg Community Unit School District 5A in 2024-25 school year
text:
Stewardson-Strasburg Community Unit School District 5A welcomed 427 students in the 2024-25 school year, according to the Illinois State Board of Education.
This represents a 2.9% increase over the previous school year.
Stewardson-Strasburg Elementary School had the largest enrollment in the district with 287 students.
Stewardson-Strasburg Community Unit School District 5A roughly covers schools within Shelby County and has a main office in Strasburg.
In 2022, Illinois had 1,925,415 students enrolled in a total of 3,977 schools. There were 130,467 teachers in the public schools, or roughly one teacher for every 15 students, compared to the national average of 1:16.
K-12 enrollment has been declining in Illinois for many years, reflecting demographic changes. Combined public and private K-12 enrollment dropped three percent between the 2019-2020 and 2020-2021 school year (60,900 students), far more than the typical 0.5 percent to 1.5 percent annual enrollment declines in Illinois over the last 5 years.
| School | Enrollment | Change from Previous Year (%) |
|---|---|---|
| Stewardson-Strasburg Elementary School | 287 | 5.1% |
| Stewardson-Strasburg High School | 140 | -1.4% |
Information in this article was obtained from the Illinois State Board of Education. The source data can be found here.
